title: Amphion benchmark manifest
description: Lists the songs in the accuracy benchmark (RC-10, RISK-01). Audio is never committed (OD-04); each entry names the private file and its SHA-256, and points to the committed reference tab.

id.description: Short kebab-case name. Also the name of the reference file.

input.description: How the audio got to the app: an imported file (upload) or a phone-mic recording (mic). Scored separately (RC-10).

instruments.description: The parts the reference covers. A part not listed must be null in the reference file.

audioFile.description: File name in the private audio folder (benchmark/audio/, gitignored). The exact file that was analyzed (RC-19).

duration.description: Length of the audio file in seconds. At most 180 (RC-07).

source.description: Where audioFile came from, when it is a cut of a longer file.

reference.description: Path of the reference tab, relative to benchmark/.

referenceStatus.description: draft-from-pipeline: written from the pipeline's own output and not yet checked, so it proves nothing about accuracy. from-published-tab: notes transcribed from a published tab of the song and lined up to the audio by an alignment script; not checked by ear. draft-from-pitch-tracking: notes found by pitch tracking the recording (pYIN, not the pipeline); not checked by ear. checked: Elijah has checked every part by ear and corrected it.
